settings.baseline: constant zero X; all confidence/baseline features in unpenalized U
settings.intervals: conditional on OOF fits; intersection of all participating folds; any undefined bootstrap draw makes the entire interval unavailable
amendments: conformal calibration split within held-out folds

conventions.table_effects: row and column: half-sum contrasts; interaction: difference of differences
conventions.folds: 2x2 table: one fold assignment balanced over joint correctness categories; other fits: stratified on their own label; bootstrap within participating fold intersections
conventions.missing_disp_full: path and float16 last-position checks remain; state conformal falls back to last position
conventions.carries: sum carry values over decimal columns, pure additions only
conventions.family_mean: equal weights across all run families; missing numeric leaves and incomplete bootstrap intervals are unavailable

settings.output_identity_tokens: valid answer tokens saved by the collection
